andrewxhill.bio: Andrew W. Hill co-founded Recall, and Textile before it. He works on thwip, which attaches signed CI evidence to the commit that produced it.

carsonfarmer.bio: Carson Farmer is CTO and a co-founder of Recall, which he started after Textile and a career in academia. He works on thwip's merge queue and on how its proofs get verified.

product-agent.note: Drafted by an agent working in this repository. A named human reviews and takes accountability; see reviewedBy on the post.
